title: Until the Sun Comes Up
summary: River needs you to hold a Badlands farmhouse until dawn for a nineteen-year-old witness the ring wants dead.
description: The ring's youngest phone man wants out and will testify. River promised him a safe place until dawn at a Badlands farmhouse, and River needs a second gun.

start.bringUp: The ring's youngest phone man wants out and will testify, and River promised him a safe place until dawn. He is bad at promises and needs a second gun. Bring it up as a favour, and do not joke about it.

farm.name: the Badlands farm outside the city

porch.name: the porch of the Badlands farmhouse

RW5.open.01.text: V. I need you for one night.

RW5.open.02.text: A witness. Nineteen, scared, ready to talk about the ring.

RW5.open.03.text: I promised him a safe place until dawn. I'm bad at promises.

RW5.open.04.text: Can you stay up with me? All night. No guarantees.

RW5.open.05.text: Farm outside the city. Pin's coming. Bring ammo, not coffee.

RW5.s2.01.text: I was late once. A kid waited at a window. I don't talk about it.

RW5.s2.02.text: That's it. A house, a barn, a lot of dark.

RW5.s3.02.text: Cellar. Door shut. Nobody opens it but me.

RW5.s3.03.text: Door, loft, or yard. Pick one. I'll cover the window.

RW5.s3.04.text: Which do you trust more, your aim or your ears?

RW5.h1.01.text: Car on the road. Three. Wait for the lights.

RW5.h1.03.text: On foot, through the field. They're counting on the dark.

RW5.h1.05.text: Truck. Two heavies. Don't waste ammo on the truck.

RW5.h1.07.text: Why did I take the first case? Want to hear it? I won't ask twice.

RW5.bark.down.a.text: One less. Keep your head down.

RW5.d.01.text: Sun's up. We held. He's alive.

RW5.d.03.text: Joss says I'm bad at being present. Tonight I was.

RW5.d.04.text: What does being present look like to you?

RW5.close.01.text: We kept it. Thank you. For tonight.

g1.asks: Can you stay up with me? All night.
g1.know: You know the case, the witness and the farm.
g1.wants: V to commit without being talked into it.

g2.asks: Which do you trust more, your aim or your ears?
g2.know: You know the three positions and their sightlines.
g2.secret: You think V should take the loft.

g3.asks: Why did I take the first case? Want to hear it?
g3.know: You know nothing of your parents' case beyond the profile.
g3.secret: The ghost behind every case, whose name you do not say.
g3.wants: To say it quietly to someone who stays.

g4.asks: What does being present look like to you?
g4.know: You know how the night ended and Joss's complaint.
g4.secret: You are afraid you only learn this on nights like this.

stages.label: River asks for one night
stages.objective: Answer River's call from the Heywood meeting place
stages.know: You are calling V from the Heywood meeting place. You promised a witness a safe place until dawn, and you are bad at promises.
stages.wants: V to come to the Heywood meeting place and stay up all night.

stages.label: V drives River to the farm
stages.objective: Drive River out to the Badlands farm
stages.know: V is driving out of the city toward the Badlands farm, twenty-five game minutes away. River is in the passenger seat with the witness on his mind.
stages.wants: V to get to the farm before the light goes.

stages.label: V picks a position at the farmhouse
stages.objective: Pick a position at the farmhouse with River
stages.know: You are at the farmhouse. The witness is in the cellar, and you will take the kitchen window. V picks one of three positions, and you tell V the sightlines.
stages.wants: V to pick a position and tell you which one.

stages.label: River holds the farm until dawn
stages.objective: Hold the farmhouse yard and kitchen with River until dawn
stages.know: The ring is sending three attacks before dawn: a car of three on the road, four on foot through the field, then two heavies behind a stolen truck. The witness must still be alive at six.
stages.wants: V to hold the farm and keep the witness alive until the sun comes up.

stages.label: River and V on the porch at dawn
stages.objective: Sit on the farmhouse porch with River at dawn
stages.know: The sun is up and the witness is alive. Han's car is on its way for him. You are sitting on the porch with V.
stages.wants: V to sit with you on the porch for a while.

dawn.memory: You and River held a Badlands farmhouse until dawn for a witness, and his promise was kept.

lost.memory: The witness did not live to see the sun come up, and River stopped texting you first.

left.memory: You left the Badlands farm before dawn, and River said it was fine.

declined.memory: You said no to the farm, and River said he would work out another way to keep the witness safe.
